timeline.subtitle: Q3 Highlights
timeline.narration: Welcome to the quarterly review. Here are the highlights from Q3.

timeline.heading: Key Wins
timeline.narration: Revenue grew twenty four percent, churn fell three points, and we closed two new enterprise accounts.

timeline.heading: Monthly Recurring Revenue ($k)
timeline.narration: Monthly recurring revenue climbed from four hundred ten thousand in July to five hundred twelve thousand in September.
